WITH facebook_users AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM public.users
  WHERE traffic_source = 'Facebook'
),
distinct_orders_per_user AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.user_id,
    oi.order_id,
    MIN(oi.created_at) as order_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY oi.user_id ORDER BY MIN(oi.created_at)) as order_sequence
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN facebook_users fu ON fu.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01'
    AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
first_second_only AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    order_id,
    order_date,
    order_sequence
  FROM distinct_orders_per_user
  WHERE order_sequence IN (1, 2)
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT 
    f.user_id,
    f.order_date as first_order,
    s.order_date as second_order,
    (s.order_date::date - f.order_date::date) as days_gap
  FROM first_second_only f
  JOIN first_second_only s ON f.user_id = s.user_id 
    AND f.order_sequence = 1 
    AND s.order_sequence = 2
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_gap) as median_days
FROM gaps

SELECT 
  DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at)::date AS acquisition_month,
  COUNT(*) AS total_users,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.order_items oi 
    WHERE oi.user_id = u.id 
    AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND oi.created_at < u.created_at + INTERVAL '30 days'
    AND oi.created_at >= u.created_at
  )) AS users_with_order,
  ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.order_items oi 
    WHERE oi.user_id = u.id 
    AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND oi.created_at < u.created_at + INTERVAL '30 days'
    AND oi.created_at >= u.created_at
  ))::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::numeric, 4) AS share_with_order
FROM public.users u
WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY share_with_order DESC

WITH facebook_users AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM public.users
  WHERE traffic_source = 'Facebook'
),
user_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.user_id,
    MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY oi.user_id ORDER BY MIN(oi.created_at)) AS order_rank
  FROM public.order_items oi
  WHERE oi.user_id IN (SELECT id FROM facebook_users)
    AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01'
    AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY oi.order_id, oi.user_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    order_date,
    order_rank,
    LAG(order_date) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_rank) AS prev_order_date
  FROM user_orders
),
second_third_gaps AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM (order_date - prev_order_date)) AS days_between
  FROM ranked_orders
  WHERE order_rank = 3
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_between) AS median_days
FROM second_third_gaps

WITH organic_users AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM public.users
  WHERE traffic_source = 'Organic'
),
user_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.user_id,
    MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY oi.user_id ORDER BY MIN(oi.created_at)) AS order_rank
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN organic_users ou ON ou.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01'
    AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, DATE(oi.created_at)
),
user_order_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    order_date,
    order_rank,
    LEAD(order_date) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_date) AS next_order_date
  FROM user_orders
),
days_between AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM (next_order_date - order_date))::int AS days_to_next_order
  FROM user_order_pairs
  WHERE order_rank = 1 AND next_order_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_to_next_order) AS median_days
FROM days_between

WITH first_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    MIN(order_id) AS first_order_id
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
    AND status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY user_id
),
order_values AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.order_id,
    oi.user_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status <> 'Cancelled' THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS order_value,
    CASE 
      WHEN fo.first_order_id = oi.order_id THEN 'first'
      ELSE 'repeat'
    END AS order_type
  FROM public.order_items oi
  LEFT JOIN first_orders fo ON fo.user_id = oi.user_id
  WHERE oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
    AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY oi.order_id, oi.user_id, fo.first_order_id
)
SELECT 
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FILTER (WHERE order_type = 'first') -
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FILTER (WHERE order_type = 'repeat') AS difference
FROM order_values

WITH user_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    order_id,
    created_at,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at ASC) AS order_seq
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE status <> 'Cancelled' 
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' 
    AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY user_id, order_id, created_at
),
first_second_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN order_seq = 1 THEN created_at END) AS first_order_date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN order_seq = 2 THEN created_at END) AS second_order_date
  FROM user_orders
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING MAX(order_seq) >= 2
),
days_between AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    (second_order_date::date - first_order_date::date) AS days_between
  FROM first_second_orders
  WHERE second_order_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_between)::numeric, 2) AS percentile_95
FROM days_between
